items.title: Jack DeJohnette interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 7, 2025
items.q: And were you playing early rock & roll like Chuck Berry and Little Richard, that kind of thing?

ctx.x: Yeah I mean it was different types of dances going on and things like the cha-cha-cha and certain other things like — actually people played to some swing music too, also, and some pop music also. So yeah generally that worked out pretty good.
And were you playing early rock & roll like Chuck Berry and Little Richard, that kind of thing?
Yeah and what’s the name — Fats Domino. And I also spent a little time in a cappella doo-wop groups too, singing with them.
